notes.title: Indie Game Utsav! [ComicCon x Kamla]
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to announce that Kamla, our horror game steeped in Indian folklore, is now featured as part of the Comic Con x Indie Game Utsav on Steam! 

This celebration brings together over 100 incredible indie titles from across India — a powerful showcase of the country’s creativity and storytelling in games. Kamla stands among them, offering a chilling experience inspired by age-old legends, forgotten rituals, and the shadows of rural India.

It’s an amazing moment for Indian indie games, and we’re proud to share Kamla with players looking for something truly haunting and homegrown.

Your support helps summon even darker tales.

notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.notes:
After months of intense hard work, we are happy to finally to announce a Release date for Kamla.

The game will come out on steam on 7th May 2024 with a launch discount of 20% for all regions.

Cheers to the whole team and thanks to each and every wishlist we have gotten so far, Kamla is our debut project and we are only planning to go bigger and better as time goes on.

Madmantra aims to be one of the forefronts when it comes to culturally rooted games from india aimed at the global audience.

notes.title: Kamla - Development Update [Graphics and Lighting]
notes.notes:
The development of kamla has been accelerating in past few months, based on the feedback we have gotten from the community we have improved the graphics of the game in a major way with better post process and detailed lighting work. 

[b]We have taken the approach of making things scarier and taking everything to a spookier level with a darker lighting direction.
Below are some new screenshots, feel free to comment and share what you think.[/b]
